epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase local stack successful startup rate from 0% to >99%
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file starting the full stack and exposing a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add docker-compose for full stack deployment
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker-compose setup for this epic, I want to configure the full stack containers and a health-check, so that the local environment verification is achievable with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unstarted environment, When running docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the stack is running, When calling the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a healthy status.
Given a local testing environment, When the integration tests run, Then they verify the stack starts and health-checks correctly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local environment startup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time spent updating catalog materials from >5 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Update existing UI to support editing and deleting epidemiological materials using existing API endpoints

slices.title: Patch existing UI to support material update and delete
slices.jtbd: When implementing the edit and delete functionality for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI components, so that users can manage the catalog without needing a new UI layer.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user clicks edit and saves changes, Then the UI sends a PUT request updating the material.
Given an existing material, When a user clicks delete, Then the UI sends a DELETE request and removes it from the view.
Given the automated test suite, When E2E and unit tests run, Then the edit and delete flows pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to update or delete a material from >5 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When using the system, I want to confirm my identity, so that sensitive data remains secure from unapproved changes.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized data modification rate from >0% to 0%
requirements: R1: Implement authentication to block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating materials

slices.title: Patch existing application with authentication mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to enforce login requirements on existing code, so that unauthorized access to the knowledge base is blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to view the catalog, Then they are redirected to a login prompt.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then the action is blocked.
Given the QA test suite, When security integration tests run, Then all restricted endpoints reject unauthenticated requests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incident rate from 100% to 0%
